links.outcome: Clinician agreement with model segmentations (no significant error) and interrater agreement on retrospective clinical test set
links.effect: Clinicians agreed with DenseNet (DSC 0.831) more than U-Net (DSC 0.759): 83.8% vs 79.3%; interrater agreement 87.9% vs 72.7%.
links.quote: Our DWI segmentation tool achieved high performance with clinical review providing meaningful performance evaluation.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates deep learning models for stroke infarct segmentation using both traditional overlap metrics and clinician review (expert evaluation of significant errors), but it tests model performance rather than a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
